consumer: The GUI status panel renderer, asking 'what stamina/pain value would be DISPLAYED to the player in the status panel' (a formatted/filtered view), not the raw internal counter.
scope: The displayed/perceived view of stamina and pain as the status panel would render them (display transform/clamp applied), not the raw uncapped engine state.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar (scalars) writes raw engine getters get_stamina()/get_pain() straight into JSON, bypassing any display formatting the status panel applies.
divergence: A state with very high pain: the status panel renders a clamped/perceived pain value (capped display) while get_pain() returns the raw uncapped counter, so the exported number diverges from what the panel would actually show.
